correctness.rationale: Associated Legendre cosine/sine basis spans complex H_l with dimension 2l+1. On a fixed meridian, restriction of homogeneous degree-l harmonic is a parity-restricted trigonometric polynomial with exponent frequencies l,l-2,...,-l, so the l+1 half-circle nodes s_j=πj/(l+1) yield a DFT after column phases. P_l^m(cos s) have distinct nonzero leading s^m orders and thus form a basis: A invertible. For m>=1 functions vanish at the north pole; unisolvency on all l+1 nodes implies B of remaining l nodes invertible. Evaluation M is block-upper/lower triangular with sine block B diag(sin(mtheta)), giving exact determinant, null modes, rational denominator floor(l/q), and minimal cardinality. Near resonance, uniformly invertible block transforms isolate simple sine factors; exactly floor(l/q) singular values vanish linearly. Independently evaluated numerical Legendre sample matrices at l=1,2,3,4,6; ranks and determinants match, including q=3 resonances.
